native_adaptation: Packed original RGBA textures; material alpha cutoff 0.93; continuous mesh skin; head proportion increased 35% about the neck; fourteen bone bindings per actor driven by familiar joint targets; native facial geometry. Raster line art is not editable native drawing strokes.
limits: Front three-quarter view only; deformation is demonstrated only within this excerpt's poses. Extreme action and new views require suitable authored drawings.
